The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `1433` (see `MsSqlBuilder.MsSqlPort`)
- Environment variable: `ACCEPT_EULA=Y`
- Environment variable: `SQLCMDDBNAME=master` (see `MsSqlBuilder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `SQLCMDUSER=sa`
- Environment variable: `MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=yourStrong(!)Password` (see `MsSqlBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `SQLCMDPASSWORD=yourStrong(!)Password` (see `MsSqlBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the `sqlcmd` utility runs `SELECT 1;` successfully.
- Startup callback: Creates the configured MsSql database.
